subject: Problem Inferring Parameters for an ODE

messages.author: 87d6a01c1ab6ddf0
messages.subject: Problem Inferring Parameters for an ODE
parts:
I am generating values from an ODE with a given set of parameters and then trying to infer them. Given the observations are exact, I should get a good fit. However I am getting a very poor fit. Probably I have made a mistake in specifying the model for inference but my search of this mailing list has revealed that other users seem be experiencing issues when working with ODEs in Stan.

Perhaps someone could take a look at my model and tell me whether there is a problem with the model or this is another manifestation of the ODE issues other users are experiencing.

The parameters I am using to generate the data are

(0.0026, 0.5)

Running the model takes a long time

#  Elapsed Time: 39.8987 seconds (Warm-up)
#                99.4783 seconds (Sampling)
#                139.377 seconds (Total)

and gives incorrect answers

                mean se_mean
theta[1]       12.81    7.63
theta[2]        5.13    0.00

Many thanks, Dominic.

PS I seem to be unable to upload files so I have to insert them as code blocks below.

sirGenerate.stan


functions {
  real[] simple_SIR(real t,
                    real[] y,
                    real[] theta,
                    real[] x_r,
                    int[] x_i) {
    real dydt[3];
    dydt[1] <- - theta[1] * y[2] * y[1];
    dydt[2] <- theta[1] * y[2] * y[1] - theta[2] * y[2];
    dydt[3] <- theta[2] * y[2];
    return dydt;
  }
}

data {
  int<lower=0> N_t;
  real t[N_t];
  real y0[3];
  real theta[2];
}

transformed data {
  real t0;
  real x_r[0];
  int x_i[0];
  t0 <- 0;
}

model {
}

generated quantities {
  real y[N_t, 3];
  y <- integrate_ode(simple_SIR, y0, t0, t, theta, x_r, x_i);
}


sirInfer.stan

functions {
  real[] sir(real t,
             real[] y,
             real[] theta,
             real[] x_r,
             int[] x_i) {
    real dydt[3];
    dydt[1] <- - theta[1] * y[1] * y[2];
    dydt[2] <-   theta[1] * y[1] * y[2] - theta[2] * y[2];
    dydt[3] <-   theta[2] * y[2];
    return dydt;
  }
}


data {
  int<lower=1> N_t;
  real t[N_t];
  real z[N_t];
  real y0[3];
}

transformed data {
  real t0;
  real x_r[0];
  int x_i[0];
  t0 <- 0;
}

parameters {
  real<lower=0> theta[2];
}

model {
  real y_hat[N_t,3];
  theta[1] ~ cauchy(0,1);
  theta[2] ~ cauchy(0,1);
  y_hat <- integrate_ode(sir, y0, t0, t, theta, x_r, x_i);
  for (i in 1:N_t) {
    z[i] ~ normal(y_hat[i,2], 0.15);
  }
}
